name: infinite-voices
summary: Reason about a person, cast a distinct Qwen3-TTS instruct, bind it to an office agent, then speak.

steps.does: POST /v1/voices/design and keep the voice only if it would not be confused with one already in the library
POST /v1/office/agents with clave, rol, modelo, estado, voice_id
Write one to three spoken sentences in the voice's language
POST /v1/audio/speech with voice_id. PCM 16-bit mono 24 kHz
